doc.title: Trip to Lisbon
doc.body:
# Trip to Lisbon

We land on Friday at 14:10. Ana books the flat, Bo finds a place for dinner, Cy brings the good camera.

## Before we go

- [x] Train tickets
- [ ] Flat near Alfama
- [ ] Dinner on Friday — somewhere with fado?
- [ ] Tell the neighbours about the cat

## Saturday

Morning at the Feira da Ladra, then the tram up to the castle. *Lunch is whoever finds a table first.*

> Bring the good camera.

doc.title: Team weekly
doc.body:
# Team weekly

**Monday.** The release went out. Two reports came in over the weekend, both about the login page on older phones.

**What we decided**

1. Fix the login page first, before anything new.
2. Dana writes the release notes; everyone adds a line about their part.
3. No meeting on Friday.

**Open**

- Who takes the support rota next month?
- The office plant is dying again.

doc.title: Reading notes: The Left Hand of Darkness
doc.body:
# The Left Hand of Darkness

Half way through. Genly keeps reading everyone through his own habits, and the book keeps letting him be wrong about it.

Lines to keep:

- "The only thing that makes life possible is permanent, intolerable uncertainty."
- The chapter told as a myth, about the two brothers.

Question for the group: does the ice crossing work because it is slow?

comment.text: There is a place in Alfama my cousin swears by. I will ask.
And the spare battery this time.

comment.quote: Who takes the support rota next month?
comment.text: I can, if someone covers the first week.
